before.measured_fact: The main number viewport is 1356 CSS px wide inside a 1280 CSS px browser viewport. scrollWidth equals clientWidth, so this number region itself cannot expose the clipped suffix with End. Page-level overflow was hidden by the parent panel scroller.
before.image_observation: Main unit/copy row and format label interfere visually. No old live/format DOM intersection was recorded; the new assertion adds that measurement.

previous_ci.focus_pixel_case: passes in all three engines after native 4px inset ring
previous_ci.overall: failure solely from unchanged minimatch audit; Pages skipped

classification: Additional WP-09 product layout defect discovered in fresh valid full-viewport production images; existing successful tests did not assert panel overflow. NOT a claim that the original audit digit/swap collision was proven.
fix: Explicit minmax(0,1fr) main grid column prevents intrinsic-width track growth.
Main content rows retain max-content height; the panel scrolls vertically.
Keep main number, unit and copy in one bounded flex row; the number shrinks into its own keyboard-accessible scroll region.
new_regressions: No horizontal overflow in main/currency/unit-grid panels.
Zero intersection of main result-row children with the format controls.
Long main number must actually overflow its own viewport and reach both sign and exponent end via real Home/End.
All previous precision, selection, clipboard, line, page, swap and native capture assertions retained.
clipboard_scope: Chromium uses native browser clipboard API; Firefox/WebKit use the unchanged explicit in-memory fixture. Physical OS clipboard and screenreader coverage not claimed.
new_diff_validation: Requires own full CI and new image inspection; older green tests do not validate this fix.
